website.note: Pipeline integrated on homepage; nimacimab CB1 inhibitor for obesity highlighted as sole clinical asset.

ctgov.note: Two studies: SBI-100 OE Phase 2 in glaucoma (COMPLETED) and Nimacimab/CBeyond Phase 2 in obesity (ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING).

pipeline.modality: Monoclonal antibody (humanized IgG4, negative allosteric modulator)
pipeline.license_origin: Acquired via Bird Rock Bio acquisition (Aug 2023)

indications.trial_design: Randomized, placebo-controlled Phase 2a; QW nimacimab and QW nimacimab co-administered with semaglutide vs placebo; 26-week treatment with extension
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING; topline data presented Nov 2025 - combo arm showed additional weight loss vs semaglutide alone; full extension data expected Q3 2026
key_milestones: Topline Phase 2a Oct/Nov 2025: combo additive weight loss

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Phase 2 COMPLETED but not mentioned in 10-K Product Candidate section; Skye has pivoted entirely to nimacimab/obesity. Asset appears deprioritized.
